title: A paged data exporter
description:
Export every record from a paged API to CSV text, streaming page by page.

```
page 1: 100 records ... page 5: 37 records
437 records written, 1 bad record skipped (missing email)
stopped early with a limit of 150 -> 2 pages fetched
```
hints: `yield* page.items` inside the paging loop gives one stream of records (lesson 8.02).
A CSV field needs quotes when it contains a comma, a quote or a new line; double any quotes inside it.
requirements: An async generator walks the pages through a fake `fetchPage(cursor)` until there is no next cursor.
Helper generators `filter`, `map` and `take` build the pipeline; a CSV writer escapes commas and quotes.
A limit stops the export early without fetching more pages.
stretch: Write the CSV to a file in Node.js with a write stream, one page at a time.
